messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: GPU pool 'us-east1-pt-1' reporting 98% utilization and autoscaler unable to provision additional instances due to quota errors. Severity: P1 :rotating_light:

alice chen: I'm on call. Looking at the pool now. Any customer-facing impact? :thinking_face:

miguel: We're seeing request queue growth on inference API v2 in us-east1. 90s p99 latency spike and 20% 429s from internal rate limiter.

sre-oncall: Logs show GCE API returns 403 Quota exceeded for `compute.gpus` when creating instance group members. Sample: `googleapi: Error 403: Quota 'GPUS' exceeded for project`.

ml-infra: Confirmed. Autoscaler attempted 6 scale-up ops over the past 5m; all failed with `RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED` and `quota limit exceeded`.

support-liaison: Support ticket #C-23458 opened by Enterprise customer AcmeCorp reporting degraded throughput on prediction endpoint. They see timeouts.

alice chen: Marking incident P1. Notifying product/SRE/sales. Re-routing traffic? Can we shift AcmeCorp region to us-west1 temporarily?

cloud-ops: us-west1 has capacity but model container images need GPU variant; can we fallback to a CPU-only mode for best-effort? That will increase latency.

deploy-bot: Canary fallback triggered for route `/predict` -> model:resnet-12-cpu (non-GPU) in us-west1 (automated fallback).

miguel: Suggest reducing per-request concurrency and enabling prefix-KV caching to relieve GPU demand. Also we can reduce batch size to lower memory pressure.

sre-oncall: Trying emergency quota backoff: applying `gcloud compute project-info describe --project redwood-prod` to check quotas. Running now.

sre-oncall: (runs) `gcloud compute quotas list --filter="metric:GPUS" --regions=us-east1` -> consumed=210, limit=220. But there are pending reservations blocking 16 GPUs in `reserved-pools`.

ml-infra: We can cancel pending offline reservations for non-critical experiments. Miguel can you identify the reservation IDs? Use `gcloud compute reservations list --filter="labels:experiment=true"`

miguel: Found 2 reservations: `res-ex-37` (8 GPUs) and `res-ex-12` (8 GPUs). Both are labeled `experiment:ci`. I can cancel `res-ex-12` now to free 8 GPUs.

alice chen: Please proceed. Meanwhile, enable autoscaler fallback policy to allow cross-region scale-out to `us-west1` until quota is raised.

cloud-ops: Cross-region fallback enabled for eligible pools. Note: we need network egress rules and model syncing—can take 45s.

support-liaison: Communicating to AcmeCorp: "We're actively mitigating by redistributing some traffic and freeing reserved GPU capacity; ETA ~5-10min for impact reduction." Sending now.

miguel: Cancelled `res-ex-12`. Confirmed 8 GPUs freed. Confirmed new attempt to create instances succeeded once we freed them: autoscaler create returned 200 for two new nodes.

sre-oncall: Observability: queue length dropping from 1200 -> 400 over 3min, 429 rate down to 3%. p95 latency returning to normal.

alice chen: Good. Next: open ticket with GCP to request quota increase for GPUS in us-east1 to 400 and request bump for reserved capacity to avoid future stall. Assign to cloud-ops.

cloud-ops: Ticket created with GCP: INC12345678. Requesting quota increase and asking for expedited review. ETA 24-48h.

ml-infra: Post mortem actions: 1) alert rule for reserved reservations > 10% of regional quota, 2) automate cancellation of experiment reservations older than 6h when regional utilization > 90%, 3) add preflight check for autoscaler that simulates quota availability before scaling.

alice chen: Oncall handoff: I'm handing to @miguel for next hour while I coordinate customer comms and postmortem. Miguel please continue watch and escalate if anything reoccurs.

miguel: Taking over. Will monitor dashboards. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident P1 | CLOSED to P2 at 2456789400 (mitigated -- capacity restored via reservation cancellation and cross-region fallback). Final notes saved to #incidents-runbook.

alice chen: Thanks team. I'll draft the postmortem and share in #postmortems within 24h. :white_check_mark:
